Rae (CS): Heads-up 1 Orchard Labs embed spend popped overnight, need a short QBR ask and mitigation notes.
Dex (AE): saw alert. Looks like a large ingestion backfill and batch_size jumped.
Priya (Solutions): confirmed. Quick estimate: +$14.2k/mo vs baseline. Drafting 3 tactics: throttles, backfill sampling, quant.
Rae (CS): QBR slide needs risk level + proposed smoothing credit. Can Finance propose options?
Marco (Finance): we can offer a $4k one-off credit if Orchard signs 60-day reserved capacity pilot. Need CS to coordinate commitment timeline.
Priya (Solutions): here's a concise projection:
```
Forecast now: $59,200/mo
Baseline: $45,000/mo
Variance: +$14,200 (+31.6%) -> renewal-risk flag
```
Dex (AE): please include a tiny ops snippet we can send to their infra team.
Priya (Solutions): snippet: ```yaml
embeddings:
  realtime_batch: 8
  backfill_batch: 24
  sampling: 0.25
  kv_cache: true
```
Rae (CS): scheduling 30-min enablement demo Wed 9am PT. Action owners: Priya (playbook + snippet), Marco (credit language), Dex (gather activation logs), Rae (QBR slide + customer call).
Ping-bot: Reminder - QBR decks due in 36 hours.
Rae (CS): will post playbook and finance language here after calls. Thanks all :thumbsup:
